versions.changelog:
Initial release of airdrop-alert.

- Monitor and track potential crypto airdrops with Telegram alerts.
- Get notified of new airdrop opportunities (5 daily alerts for free users).
- Pro plan offers unlimited alerts, early project notifications, eligibility checker, auto-generated task lists, multi-account support, and estimated airdrop values.
- Simple commands to discover, check eligibility, and set custom alerts.
